request.description: Crooked silver three arm candelabrum. A useful object for the world of Haunted Manor & Ghost Investigation. Gothic mystery pixel art, charcoal plum outlines, dusty walnut, faded burgundy velvet, antique silver and parchment ivory, occasional cold spectral mint, eerie but readable. Materials consistent with the named item: dark walnut, faded velvet, tarnished silver, chipped porcelain, frosted glass, black lace. Crisp native 64x64 pixel-art inventory icon. Exactly the primary item or the small connected assembly named above, with only its specified parts. Front three-quarter view seen slightly from above; coherent upper-left lighting. Center the entire object with at least four transparent pixels on every side; aim for 44 to 54 pixels on its longest side, up to 56 for a long tool. Clear silhouette, deliberate square pixel clusters, approximately one-pixel dark colored outline, three-tone material shading. Clean opaque sprite pixels on fully transparent background. No scenery, floor, pedestal, framing border, checkerboard pattern, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, soft antialiasing, blur or photographic texture. Do not add wings, horns, eyes, limbs, crystals or decorative effects unless the item description explicitly names them.
